001package net.tnemc.folia.impl;
002
003import net.tnemc.plugincore.core.compatibility.CmdSource;
004import net.tnemc.plugincore.core.compatibility.PlayerProvider;
005import net.tnemc.plugincore.core.io.message.MessageData;
006import net.tnemc.plugincore.core.io.message.MessageHandler;
007import revxrsal.commands.bukkit.actor.BukkitCommandActor;
008
009import java.util.Optional;
010
011/** Folia command source using native Paper audiences and the region-aware player provider. */
012public final class FoliaCMDSource extends CmdSource<BukkitCommandActor> {
013
014  public FoliaCMDSource(final BukkitCommandActor actor) {
015
016    super(actor);
017  }
018
019  @Override
020  public boolean isPlayer() {
021
022    return actor.isPlayer();
023  }
024
025  @Override
026  public Optional<PlayerProvider> player() {
027
028    return actor.isPlayer()? Optional.of(new FoliaPlayerProvider(actor.asPlayer())) : Optional.empty();
029  }
030
031  @Override
032  public void message(final MessageData data) {
033
034    MessageHandler.translate(data, identifier().orElse(null), actor.sender());
035  }
036}
